course_access_groups.purpose: Constant content entitlement and provider-native course progress support.
rules: Never rename, nest, replace, or repurpose a paid or Course Access Group as a cohort marker.
Membership proves only the exact access scope recorded in this catalog; it does not prove purchase, cohort assignment, attendance, or payment state.
Full-access group contents require provider attachment readback; a group name alone is not an entitlement manifest.

marker_groups.purpose: Hidden administrator-only projections of canonical enrollment or scheduled-group assignment.
rules: A full-program buyer and a module-only buyer attending the same class block share the same class marker.
Marker groups are based on actual scheduled delivery, never on purchase scope.
Individual mentoring or supervision, individual appointments, self-paced courses, assessments, resource access, and certificate outcomes do not receive cohort markers.
Removing a marker must never revoke course access; removing course access must never rewrite class-assignment history.
The canonical ledger preserves transfers and history even when Heartbeat shows only current marker membership.

known_conflicts.summary: The April 2026 ICF tracking framework names Plutio as the student source of truth, while the accepted Company OS lifecycle architecture makes source systems authoritative for native facts and Company OS authoritative for cross-provider enrollment, entitlement, reconciliation, and action state.

Supported read-only Heartbeat tools verify full-access group and course identities but do not expose the complete group-to-content attachment graph. Published bundle promises therefore remain provisional until a documented provider read surface or exact owner-maintained mapping is available.

The inactive pcc-exam-prep-individual checkout points at the ACC Practice Test group, while Heartbeat exposes a distinct PCC/MCC Practice Test group and course. No activation or correction is authorized by this catalog task.

The Student Roster Product Map records full purchases in one Full Program column and does not materialize the component entitlements, allowances, class assignments, or consumption state promised by the bundle.

Heartbeat currently contains three groups named September 2026 plus MCS Practicum - September 2026. They cannot be treated as canonical cohort markers without exact purpose and membership-authority reconciliation.

Current public pages confirm inclusion of mentoring, supervision, evaluation, exam preparation, recording review, and Coaching Tools Plus, but several exact quantities, resubmission rights, consumption rules, and full-group attachments are not present in the supported source surfaces.
